settings.hero_desc: A full-body Rathalos fantasy cosplay armor built from Monster Hunter - layered dragon-scale plates, winged pauldrons, sculpted helmet and gauntlets in rich red and steel. Wearable, durable and built to your character reference.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your body size, armour color and finish
settings.s1_body: From a game, film or original concept, we build full cosplay armor that's accurate, wearable and durable. This dragon-scale Rathalos suit from Monster Hunter layers sculpted plates, winged pauldrons, a detailed helmet and gauntlets into a complete costume - finished in rich metallic colours and fitted to the wearer. Ideal for competitions, conventions, brand events and serious collectors.
settings.case_body: Built For Fahads favourite character Rathalos from Monster Hunter, this full armor set turned a digital design into a wearable, competition-ready costume - accurate, durable and a showstopper on the convention floor.
settings.case_quote: The build quality is unreal and it actually fits and moves. People went crazy just by looking at it.
settings.prov_p: A character is a fantasy until you can step into it. We build armor accurate and wearable enough to bring your favourite character off the screen and onto the floor.
